granted_by: the maintainer decision of 2026-09-11 approving the execution package, AS AMENDED the same day after attempt 11, and the maintainer direction of 2026-09-12 to proceed to an actual launch rather than add another round of engineering preparation. The amendment withdrew, prospectively, both the three-session cap and the one-provider-resource-per-invocation rule. Attempt 12 was a $0.0000 provider capacity refusal -- the create was declined, no resource existed, nothing billed -- which the package explicitly treats as handled by backing off and requesting a host at a better moment, with no repository change required. Money, science, price and the one-billing-resource invariant are unchanged. Terms: configs/experiments/phase_c1/authorization.json:execution_package. Attempt 12's closeout: logs/runs/phase_c1/attempt12/closeout/outcome.json.

stage_conditions.replay: stop before any recovery training on a parent or incumbent digest mismatch; preserve the evidence and treat it as the attempt's result
stage_conditions.device_handoff: stop before recovery if the card is not released
stage_conditions.training: all six trainings must complete before any evaluation; a training failure is C1_INCOMPLETE, not a partial confirmation experiment
stage_conditions.generation_admission: no probe is scored unless the generation protocol observed from its own raw summaries is comparable to the attested C1 protocol
stage_conditions.decision: stage I requires six complete admitted and scored probes
stage_conditions.retry: THIS authorization funds exactly ONE launcher session. Inside that session the launcher may take up to the approved number of acquisition draws, replacing a host that was created and never became usable; at most ONE resource may be billing at any instant, enforced by SessionRunner.release_and_confirm, and every draw shares this session's single ceiling. A FURTHER session needs a new grant, a new launch-bound readiness record, a new authorization and a new bundle -- see execution_package for when that is permitted without a further maintainer decision.

scope_note: exactly one C1 launch under the UNCHANGED frozen C1 protocol at a hard ceiling of $15.1475: the frozen fixed-path ATTENTION isolation, 2 frozen arms x 3 frozen fresh paired seeds = exactly six E1_KD_HEAVY_0860K recovery trainings; ALL SIX trainings complete before any confirmation evaluation begins; exactly one frozen confirmation evaluation per completed probe, each admitted against its own observed generation protocol before scoring; followed by the existing frozen GO / NO-GO / INCONCLUSIVE decision rule. Nothing in the protocol, the arms, the seeds, the battery, the recovery recipe, the generation protocol, the scoring contract, the statistic or the behavioural vetoes may move.
enforcement: the launcher loads this artifact and refuses to create a pod whose priced hard threshold exceeds hard_cap_usd or per_launch_hard_usd, refuses a stage not in authorized_stages, refuses a harness that does not digest to the authorized value, and has no code path to any experiment after Phase A
scope: 2 arms x 3 fresh seeds = 6 fixed 0.86M recovery probes on one frozen path, evaluated once each on c1_confirmation_v1. No search, no ranking, no successive halving, no tie-breaking, no arm elimination, and no formal Stage-2/3 recovery.

does_not_authorize: a second launcher session under THIS grant
more than three host draws in this session
two billing resources at any instant
a draw taken without the provider confirming the previous one stopped billing
a second launch under THIS grant
any retry after formal probe training has started
a retry when it cannot be confirmed whether training started
re-running a valid INCONCLUSIVE in pursuit of a GO
a GPU class other than the accepted secure L40S
using the GPU engineering allowance for complete formal probes or for an endpoint measurement on the frozen confirmation battery

one_use: ONE grant, ONE issuance, ONE launcher session. Within the session, acquisition draws are bounded by execution_package.acquisition and never exceed one BILLING resource at a time. A failure is this session's result; a new session always uses a complete new one-use chain and never reuses a consumed one.
